events.title: Theodosius I enters Constantinople
events.description: Emperor Theodosius I made his formal entry into Constantinople. Earlier that year he had declared Nicene Christianity the faith of the empire, and he soon removed the city's Arian bishop.
events.html: Emperor Theodosius I made his formal entry into Constantinople. Earlier that year he had declared Nicene Christianity the faith of the empire, and he soon removed the city's Arian bishop.

events.title: An earthquake strikes Damascus, Antioch and Mosul
events.description: A powerful earthquake, perhaps part of a multiple event stretching from Damascus to Antioch and Mosul, struck Syria. There were an estimated 20,000 casualties in Antioch, according to the historian al-Dhahabi, and 50,000 in Mosul.

events.title: Conrad of Montferrat becomes King of Jerusalem by marriage
events.description: Conrad of Montferrat, who had held Tyre against Saladin, married Isabella I of Jerusalem and so became de facto King of Jerusalem. He was officially elected king only in April 1192, days before his murder.

events.title: Genghis Khan defeats Jalal al-Din at the Battle of the Indus
events.description: On the banks of the Indus River, Genghis Khan defeated Jalal al-Din, the last Khwarazmshah, who had rallied Khwarazmian loyalists after his father's flight and death. Jalal al-Din fought on in exile as the Khwarazmian Empire collapsed.

events.title: Joan of Arc lays siege to La Charité
events.description: On the orders of Charles VII, Joan of Arc began a siege of La Charité, held since 1423 by the warlord Perrinet Gressard. The siege lasted until 25 December and failed.
events.html: On the orders of Charles VII, Joan of Arc began a siege of La Charité, held since 1423 by the warlord Perrinet Gressard. The siege lasted until 25 December and failed.

events.title: Darwin publishes On the Origin of Species
events.description: John Murray published Charles Darwin's On the Origin of Species, setting out evolution by natural selection. The first printing of 1,250 copies was quickly taken up, and the book transformed biology.

events.title: Carter uncovers the sealed doorway of Tutankhamun's tomb
events.description: With Lord Carnarvon present, Howard Carter's team cleared the stairway and found a sealed doorway bearing Tutankhamun's name. Two days later they looked inside.
events.html: With Lord Carnarvon present, Howard Carter's team cleared the stairway and found a sealed doorway bearing Tutankhamun's name. Two days later they looked inside.

events.title: Jack Ruby shoots Lee Harvey Oswald on live television
events.description: Nightclub owner Jack Ruby shot Lee Harvey Oswald, accused of killing President Kennedy, in the basement of Dallas police headquarters. Millions saw the shooting live on television.
events.html: Nightclub owner Jack Ruby shot Lee Harvey Oswald, accused of killing President Kennedy, in the basement of Dallas police headquarters. Millions saw the shooting live on television.

events.title: Fossil hunters find 'Lucy' in Ethiopia
events.description: At Hadar, Donald Johanson and Tom Gray found the partial skeleton of a 3.2-million-year-old Australopithecus afarensis. Named Lucy, she showed that human ancestors walked upright long before brains enlarged.
